title: Category (Platform) Schema
description: Code-side declaration for a fetcher category, at fetchers/_categories/<name>.yaml. All fields optional; an empty file is valid.

config_schema.description: Config shared across every fetcher in this category. Each value declares a field; when it has an `env`, the runner injects the resolved value as that env var for every fetcher in the category.

secrets.description: Credentials shared by every fetcher in the category, declared once here instead of repeated in each fetcher.yaml. A per-fetcher secret of the same name wins.

requires.description: What must be installed for this category's fetchers to run. `paramify doctor` checks these, and only for the categories a manifest actually uses.

tools.description: External binaries the fetchers shell out to, checked against PATH.

python_packages.description: Distribution names the fetchers import (not import names — e.g. google-cloud-secret-manager, imported as google.cloud.secretmanager). Version pins are read from requirements.txt, which stays the single source of truth.

passthrough_env.description: Default ambient env vars the runner lets through its whitelist for this platform. A manifest's platforms.<category>.auth.passthrough_env adds to this set.

selector_env.description: Env vars that represent an explicit identity choice (e.g. AWS_PROFILE). When a TARGET sets one, the runner drops every var in credential_env for that invocation, so ambient static keys cannot silently outrank the identity the manifest asked for.

credential_env.description: Static credential vars superseded by a target-set selector_env var. Still passed through for ambient (target-less) collection.
